title: CCID extended-APDU buffer truncation risk
description: wp11_ccid_apdu() uses a 522-byte stack frame_in[] buffer and a single libusb_bulk_transfer() call. This is safe because wolfP11 only issues short APDUs with GET RESPONSE chaining, so no individual CCID frame exceeds 268 bytes. However the constraint is undocumented: a contributor adding extended-APDU support would cause silent frame truncation past the sequence-number check. Added comment in wp11_ccid.c lines 271-282 documenting the assumption and what must change if extended APDUs are ever added.
